Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL1240340. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL1240340. Return all rows including those without structures. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
